metadata.description: Opinionated engineering doctrine and reusable product-building workflows, delivered as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: arch-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic architecture skills (services, state, UI, auth, forms, backend modules), the arch-decision ADR workflow, the arch-contribute contribution doctrine, the arch-drift audit, and the init workflow. Required by every stack plugin.

plugins.name: arch-nextjs
plugins.description: Scaffolding and audit agents for the Next.js App Router blueprint.

plugins.name: arch-tanstack-start
plugins.description: Scaffolding and audit agents for the TanStack Start blueprint.

plugins.name: arch-nestjs-backend
plugins.description: The NestJS DDD modular-monolith blueprint, with module scaffolding, audit agents, doctrine hooks, and a settings template.

plugins.name: product-design
plugins.description: Product prototyping skill, visual-language doctrine, and rendered-page design review for high-fidelity application UI.
